Inside Macintosh: Telephony /
Chapter 4 - Call Appearances / Call Appearance Reference

Result Codes

This section describes the result codes for the functions discussed in this chapter.
telNoErr
The function completed without error.
telBadBearerType
Bad bearer type specified.
telBadCAErr
The call appearance record is invalid or cannot be found.
telBadDNErr
The directory number record is invalid or cannot be found.
telBadDNType
Bad directory number type specified.
telBadFeatureID
Bad feature ID specified.
telBadFwdType
Bad forwarding type specified.
telBadHandErr
The specified record handle is invalid.
telBadIntercomID
Bad intercom ID specified.
telBadIntExt
Bad internal/external type specified.
telBadPageID
Bad page ID specified.
telBadParkID
Bad park ID specified.
telBadPickupGroupID
Bad pickup group ID specified.
telBadRate
Bad rate specified.
telBadStateErr
Bad device state specified.
telBadTermErr
The telephone record handle is not valid.
telCANotAcceptable
Specified call appearance cannot be accepted.
telCANotDeflectable
Specified call appearance cannot be deflected.
telCANotRejectable
Specified call appearance cannot be rejected.
telCAUnavail
A call appearance is not available.
telCBErr
Call back feature not previously set.
telConfErr
A conference was not prepared.
telConfLimitErr
Specified limit is too high for current configuration.
telConfLimitExceeded
Attempted to exceed switch conference limits.
telConfNoLimit
A limit is required but was not specified.
telConfRej
A conference request was rejected.
telDetAlreadyOn
Detection is already turned on.
telFeatActive
Specified feature is already active.
telFeatNotAvail
Specified feature is subscribed but not available.
telFeatNotSub
Specified feature is not subscribed.
telFeatNotSupp
Specified feature is not supported by telephone tool.
telIntExtNotSupp
Specified internal/external type not supported by telephone tool.
telNoCallbackRef
No call back reference supplied.
telNoMemErr
Not enough memory is available.
telStateNotSupp
Specified device state not supported by telephone tool.
telTransferErr
A transfer was not prepared.
telTransferRej
A transfer request was rejected.
